resources.string: Pie Detective
Find the pie thief before it reaches the back gate!
Solve it with the Sidekick
You and 1 to 3 friendly Sidekicks hunt the pie thief together.
Two to four detectives pass the device around. Sidekicks can fill empty seats.
Case size
How many animals are in the lineup, how many clues you can ask for and how fast the thief sneaks.
Little case
Eight animals, four clues and a slow thief: great for the youngest detectives.
Medium case
Ten animals, five clues. A good mix for most families.
Big case
Twelve animals, six clues and a quick thief for practised detectives.
Sidekicks
Sidekicks take their own turns, so a small team always has a full table.
Sidekick level
Sidekick hints
A soft glow on a helpful clue. The Sidekick hint button always works, even when this is off.
Sidekick flips for us
After a clue is shown, the Sidekick turns over the animals that do not match, so you only choose, peek and tell.
Lucky peek for
Give one player a Lucky peek in each case: after it, the thief does not sneak that turn.
Turn the lens for the far player
A player sitting opposite sees the lens and trait buttons the right way up. Switch off for one person holding the device.
